purpose: Canonical registry for Maiyuri Bricks tech stack, source-of-truth boundaries, relationships, and value addition. Every new feature should consult and update this map.

components.name: Odoo ERP
components.value_addition: Authoritative business truth for revenue, orders, production, delivery, collections, and ERP activities.
constraints: Do not query Odoo from every agent; use cache/MCP

components.name: Supabase App DB
source_of_truth_for: Maiyuri app leads/workflows where Odoo is not source
components.value_addition: Operational app state and fast product workflows around sales/AI features.
constraints: Do not treat Supabase as Odoo

components.name: Todoist
components.value_addition: Execution discipline: owner, action, due date, completion trail.
constraints: No mutation without approval except approved deterministic @mention+action workflow

components.name: WhatsApp Business Profile
components.value_addition: Captures real sales/project movement from WhatsApp without requiring Ram to inspect every chat.
constraints: No automatic team/group replies without Ram explicit send/share/post instruction

components.name: Maiyuri ClickHouse
components.value_addition: High-speed memory of what happened, what changed, and how systems relate.
constraints: Derived analytics only, not transactional source of truth

components.name: ClickHouse Relationship Layer
constraints: Graph DB only later if ClickHouse views are insufficient

components.name: Agent Insight Repository
components.value_addition: Converts one-time reports into compound operational learning.

components.name: Hermes / Maiyuri Agentic OS
components.value_addition: Coordinates specialist agents into owner-action-deadline rhythm.
constraints: No WhatsApp auto-post without explicit approval

components.name: Maiyuri Intelligence MCP
components.value_addition: Authoritative tool layer for metric-backed reasoning and profit ontology.
constraints: Claims with provisional/conflicted status must not be stated as fact
Use MCP metrics instead of recomputing when available

components.name: Langfuse
components.value_addition: Shows whether AI workflows are actually instrumented and healthy.
constraints: Smoke traces are not business insight

components.name: Maiyuri Bricks App
components.value_addition: Business operating interface and customer/sales workflow surface.

components.name: Tech Stack Knowledge Map
components.value_addition: Prevents duplicate infra and makes every new feature reuse existing business capability.
constraints: Must be updated after every material infra/agent/app addition

relationships.value: Odoo transactions feed governed metrics/profit tools
Snapshots and Activity Log create execution event history
Tasks and actors become Person→Task relationships
Observed message movement logs into events
Events and cache-derived facts materialize into nodes/edges
Specialist agents write durable learning cards
Tech components/capabilities are synced as ontology nodes
New feature agents must check stack map before building
AI Quality checks traces and instrumentation health

new_feature_reuse_checklist: Can Odoo be source of truth?
Can Supabase/App DB be reused instead of a new store?
Should the action be logged to ClickHouse?
Does relationship layer need new nodes/edges?
Does Insight Repository need a durable learning card?
Which existing agent/report should consume this?
What business capability/value does this strengthen?
